title: Microsoft sample Revenue Opportunities.pbix (MIT): metadata, row counts, column aggregates, small tables and every measure, Desktop's engine vs DashCraft's VertiPaq decoder and DAX engine

cases.query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(INFO.VIEW.TABLES(), "Name", [Name], "DataCategory", [DataCategory], "Description", [Description], "IsHidden", [IsHidden], "CalculationGroupPrecedence", [CalculationGroupPrecedence])

EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(INFO.VIEW.COLUMNS(), [Type] <> "RowNumber"), "Table", [Table], "Name", [Name], "DataType", [DataType], "IsHidden", [IsHidden], "FormatString", [FormatString], "SortByColumn", [SortByColumn], "SummarizeBy", [SummarizeBy], "DataCategory", [DataCategory], "DisplayFolder", [DisplayFolder], "Description", [Description], "Expression", [Expression])
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(INFO.VIEW.MEASURES(), "Table", [Table], "Name", [Name], "IsHidden", [IsHidden], "DisplayFolder", [DisplayFolder], "Description", [Description], "Expression", [Expression])
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(INFO.MEASURES(), "Name", [Name], "FormatString", [FormatString])

EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(INFO.VIEW.RELATIONSHIPS(), "FromTable", [FromTable], "FromColumn", [FromColumn], "FromCardinality", [FromCardinality], "ToTable", [ToTable], "ToColumn", [ToColumn], "ToCardinality", [ToCardinality], "IsActive", [IsActive], "CrossFilteringBehavior", [CrossFilteringBehavior], "SecurityFilteringBehavior", [SecurityFilteringBehavior])
